title: Stimulus-triggered fate conversion of somatic cells into pluripotency
central_claims: Transient low-pH stress reprograms differentiated somatic cells into pluripotent STAP cells without nuclear transfer or transcription factors.
STAP cells contribute to chimeric embryos and germline, and support expandable pluripotent lines.

source_manifest.title: RIKEN Report on STAP Cell Research Paper Investigation
source_manifest.finding: Institutional investigation identifies two instances of research misconduct among six investigated items and calls for corrective action. Retraction is related to data reliability, not merely publishing procedure.

source_manifest.title: De Los Angeles et al. Failure to replicate the STAP cell phenomenon
source_manifest.finding: Read publisher substantive summary and extended figure legends. Seven laboratories applied two protocols; cells showed autofluorescence, not pluripotency-marker reactivation, and failed teratoma and chimera tests. Includes independent teams and a test in the originating lab; not all groups share independence.

source_manifest.title: Konno et al. STAP cells are derived from ES cells
source_manifest.finding: Read publisher summary and extended data. Whole-genome sequencing identifies ES-cell contamination in purported STAP lines; chimeras and teratomas show ES rather than STAP contribution. Different author team, same institution.

source_manifest.title: Yoshiki Sasai: Apology regarding the paper retractions
source_manifest.finding: Original coauthor says retraction removes the experimental basis and genotype discrepancies undermine even treating STAP as promising. Not independent validation.

source_manifest.title: Niwa: Investigation of the cellular reprogramming phenomenon referred to as STAP
source_manifest.finding: Original coauthor attempts original methods and concludes described STAP is not reproducible. Not counted as independent team.

search_gaps: Original publisher abstract and figure descriptions read; publisher full text inaccessible without subscription. Model input is the complete original abstract only, excluding later notices.
Seven-lab failure does not establish universal absence of every later extension or use. Utility and durability are left unknown without specific evidence.
research.summary: The specific STAP conversion claim failed independent replication and genetic identity checks; retraction followed documented data problems. Attempted reuse does not validate it. Broader reprogramming research is not graded as failed.
